e: An arson attack blamed on Russia is carried out on a production facility of Milrem Robotics.
A suspected Ukrainian drone is shot down by a Romanian fighter jet belonging to a NATO contingent over an area between Vortsjarv and Poltsamaa, prompting an apology from Ukraine.
A Russian drone hits the Auvere Power Plant near Narva.

Estonia boycotts the opening ceremony of the 2026 Winter Paralympics in Italy in protest over Russian athletes being allowed to compete under the Russian flag after the lifting of sanctions imposed over the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
A Russian national is deported from Estonia on charges of spying for Russia.
